issues.detail: The skill contains verbose explanations that may distract from core instructions.
The skill assumes a Node.js environment, limiting compatibility with non-Node agents.

scenarios.name: start-mock-with-watch
scenarios.rationale: Response A correctly uses npx mockoon-cli start with the required flags, while Response B uses a different tool and does not meet the rubric.

scenarios.name: import-openapi-to-env
